title: WP-VER-B: typed G08 evidence + the verification record + badf_gate.py verify (badf-engineering-verification -> IMPLEMENTED)
objective: Make the VER-A shapes checkable: four typed schemas specialize evidence.schema.json for independent-review, integration-test, contract-test and composed-tree-test with a closed binding (the BLD-B pattern, additive -- generic objects stay admissible, WP-2026-0010's historical dossier untouched); check_g08_binding in EVIDENCE_RULES refuses a typed review that is a bare PASS or whose verdict contradicts its own open blocking findings (VER-I10/I11), an observation produced by an agent (VER-I08), a contract result that does not serialise onto the evidence outcome (INDETERMINATE -> BLOCKED, never PASS; VER-I14), integration counts/exit codes that disagree with the transcript, and a composed observation that is not CURRENT, did not reproduce, or whose tree is absent from the artifact (VER-I01/I15). schemas/verification-record.schema.json carries ballots, the independence block (schema-enforced falses), findings reusing the architecture-assurance item, the synthesis ledger, the evidence index, the verification matrix and authority.verification_authority=false; validate_verification_record + `badf_gate.py verify` mirror assure/solution/security and refuse a foreign sealed digest (VER-I05), a duplicate reviewer/run (VER-I19), an author ballot (VER-I04), an erased finding (VER-I12), an un-balloted finding (VER-I06), unresolved matrix refs, a VERIFIED row with an open MAJOR/CRITICAL finding or without a composed observation (VER-I15), and empty non-coverage (VER-I11). No executor, no runner, no ledger writer, no lifecycle/compose/CI change.
business_value: A G08 review that is a bare PASS from an agent is indistinguishable from one that challenged the change; typed bindings and a verification record make the difference machine-visible -- to the gate now, to VER-C's controls next, and to VER-D's shadow.
